extraction_notes: HEI 10-K is heavy on broad commercial-aerospace narrative (FSG 70% of FY25 sales, mostly commercial airlines/MRO). ETG is 30% of sales, of which ~51% to U.S./foreign military, prime defense contractors, and satellite/spacecraft manufacturers. Filing names ONE specific platform (F-16) and several broad defense capability categories (TWTAs/MPMs for radar/EW/jamming, missile-seeker simulation, Hi-Rel rad-hard memory for satellites, U.S. Navy legacy hydraulic sustainment) but does NOT name specific Pentagon Program Elements (PE numbers) or named programs-of-record like CCA, Skyborg, SDA Tracking Layer, Project Maven. This narrative-style itself is a control finding — the absence of named PEs limits J-Book diagnostic power, but the broad capability claims can still be partially probed via contractor_name and category synonyms.

claims.subject: HEICO FSG
claims.source_quote: Further, we believe the FSG is a leading provider of products and services necessary to maintain up-to-date F-16 fighter aircraft operational capabilities.

claims.source_quote: overhauls industrial pumps, motors, and other hydraulic units with a focus on the support of legacy systems for the U.S. Navy

claims.object_value: DoD radar / EW / jamming / countermeasure programs

claims.claim_text: ETG designs and manufactures niche state-of-the-art simulation, testing and calibration equipment used in the development of missile seeking technology (MIRAGE IR Scene Simulator); customers include major U.S. DoD weapons laboratories and defense prime contractors.
claims.subject: HEICO ETG

claims.claim_text: ETG designs and manufactures three-dimensional microelectronic and stacked memory products principally integrated into larger subsystems equipping satellites and spacecraft (also offers rad-hard / hi-rel SRAM and EEPROM for military, space and medical platforms).
claims.subject: HEICO ETG
claims.source_quote: These products are principally integrated into larger subsystems equipping satellites and spacecraft and are also utilized in medical equipment. Additionally, the ETG designs and manufactures specialty semiconductors and offers a well-developed line of processors as well as static random-access memory (SRAM) and electronically erasable programmable read-only memory (EEPROM) products utilized on a diverse array of military, space and medical platforms.

claims.claim_text: ETG derived approximately 51%, 51% and 49% of its net sales in fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023 respectively from sale of products and services to U.S. and foreign military agencies, prime defense contractors and both commercial and defense satellite and spacecraft manufacturers. ETG is 30% of total HEI net sales in FY2025.

claims.source_quote: The ETG derived approximately 51%, 51% and 49% of its net sales in fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively, from the sale of products and services to U.S. and foreign military agencies, prime defense contractors and both commercial and defense satellite and spacecraft manufacturers.
